overloads.semanticRole: The Select RGB color command displays the system color selection window and returns the RGB value of the color selected by the user.

constraints: If defaultColor is omitted or 0, the color black is preselected when the dialog box opens.
Under Windows: if the user validates with OK, the command returns the selected color in RGB format and OK is set to 1; if the user cancels, the command returns -1 and OK is set to 0.

Under macOS: the dialog can only be closed via the close box or Esc; OK is always set to 1 regardless of user action, and the command returns the selected color, or the value passed in defaultColor if the user made no selection.
